## How to install

### Requirements

- [opencode](https://opencode.ai) 1.4.x or later
- A model provider configured in `opencode.json` (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.)

> **Note:** The model assigned to each agent must support tool calling. Models like `deepseek-r1` do not support tools and will fail in workflow sub-sessions.

### Steps

git clone https://github.com/Alex-stack-cell/opencode-bmad-workflow.git
cd opencode-bmad-workflow
./install.sh

Full documentation: https://github.com/Alex-stack-cell/opencode-bmad-workflow

> "stitch": { "type": "remote", "url": "https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp", "headers": { "Accept": "application/json", "X-Goog-Api-Key": " YOUR STITCH API KEY " } },
> 
> in opencode.json

Hey, I couldn't connect to Stitch today. It turns out the solution is to explicitly add "oauth": false to the configuration in the opencode.json file.

Here is the working snippet in case anyone else runs into the same problem:

`"stitch": {
  "type": "remote",
  "url": "https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp",
  "enabled": true,
  "oauth": false,
  "headers": {
    "X-Goog-Api-Key": "YOUR STITCH API KEY"
  }
}`
This is a much needed addition! Unlocks a critical usecase for us!
